primary.launch: interactive Claude Code CLI session (entrypoint cli) acting as orchestrator P
primary.children: Agent tool, subagent_type general-purpose, background (meta requestShape=background); grandchildren with model override haiku resolved to claude-haiku-5-5
primary.reuse: SendMessage to the returned agentId (resumes the same transcript)
primary.native_relative_layout: projects/<cwd-encoded>/<session-uuid>.jsonl and projects/<cwd-encoded>/<session-uuid>/subagents/agent-<agentId>.{jsonl,meta.json}; grandchildren stored flat in the same subagents directory with parentAgentId
primary.snapshot_method: Read-only copies of complete JSONL lines (partial trailing line dropped) plus meta.json into a private directory outside the repository; per-second background snapshots for running states. No source mutation.

ephemeral_attempts.reason: Child agent_id, spawn tool_use_id, task_started/task_notification (status, duration_ms) are in stdout, but stream usage is a non-final message-start snapshot and the child's final message is absent; result.modelUsage is a per-model aggregate of parent+child. Child self usage is unknown.

privacy.identifiers: consistent pseudonyms preserving UUID version/variant, agentId shape (a+16 hex), toolu_/msg_/req_ prefix+version marker+length, run ID shape
privacy.bodies: empty strings; notification strings reduced to task-id/tool-use-id/status/usage tags; agent-message strings reduced to the from reference; native '[Request interrupted by user]' marker kept
privacy.source_unchanged: Private snapshots were compared byte-for-byte before and after minimization; live transcripts were only read.
